thread:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: Coralix QBR scheduled Thu 11am PT. Need a 1-slide token runway, 2 commit scenarios with savings math, onboarding blockers summary, and a one-line renewal ask before Wed EOD. Assign owners?

Ravi - FinOps: I can own econ. Preference: show 14d spike window and 60d trend so we capture recent ramp + baseline. Also include per-route top 5 consumers.

Clara (SE): Onboarding status: main ingestion flow is live in staging but stalled in prod due to a cert mismatch on their infra side. Worked with their infra; fix pending rotation. Also saw high retry bursts inflating token counts. I can get logs and a small sample after I repro.

Diego (CSM): Customer feedback to capture: they asked for an "on-demand burst cushion" (temporary burst credits) and clearer per-route observability. They also asked if quantized models will keep entity alignment in outputs.

usage-bot: ALERT: coralix-prod hit 70% of monthly commit yesterday. Link: https://billing.redwood.example/customers/coralix-prod/usage

Ravi - FinOps: Initial pulls: 14d total = 18,960,412 tokens; est current month w/o change = ~23.5M. If they dont throttle, projected overage ~2.4M tokens (~$520). I'll run commit sims for +10% and +30% and produce a short table.

Ravi - FinOps: SQL used to get per-route medians:```sql
SELECT route, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tokens) AS median_tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE customer_id='coralix-prod' AND ts >= now()-interval '14 days'
GROUP BY route;
```

Clara (SE): Regarding quantized model test: I tried q2-small-quant on their templates. Most routes preserved JSON schema, but one route had whitespace differences that break a strict parser. Recommend "templating tolerance" or small parser relax for that route.

Diego (CSM): I'll gather exact customer quote for the commit ask. Also will confirm whether their infra rotation ETA is Tue noon PT.

Maya (CS): Owners: Ravi (econ + charts + alerts), Clara (integration notes + logs), Diego (customer quote + infra ETA), Maya (deck + runbook + renewal ask). 1-line renewal ask proposal: "Increase commit to 30M/mo for 12 months to cover production ramp; Redwood to provide 2 remediation credits and quarterly cost reviews." Thoughts?

Ravi - FinOps: Quick sim: current commit=25M. Scenario A (keep commit) pay-on-demand est = $10.8k/mo. Scenario B (+10% -> 27.5M) = $11.5k/mo and fewer throttles; Scenario C (+20% -> 30M) = $12.3k/mo. If they move to q2-small-quant we estimate ~17% unit cost reduction -> Scenario C net = ~$10.2k/mo effective, plus lower variance. Latency delta ~+5ms median. I'll attach CSV to /drive/coralix/qbr/ and create 70/85% alerts.

usage-bot: SCHEDULED ALERT: coralix-prod threshold=85% will auto-notify at 2025-07-02T08:00:00Z unless commit updated.

Clara (SE): I'll add a short log excerpt and the retry spike snippet to the deck. ETA for prod cert rotation confirmation Tue 11:30am PT.

Diego (CSM): Will request burst credit pilot for 30 days in case they accept the 30M commit. I'll draft the commit ask language and pull sample embed recall screenshots.

Maya (CS): Great. Reconvene Wed 4:00pm PT for final slide pass. If anyone finds a blocker DM me. :thumbsup:
